preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID every day — required at Interchange pantries (Village Church & St. Mark AME) and Jewish Community Pantry; helpful elsewhere
Call The Gathering at (414) 272-4122 to confirm no appointment is needed before your first visit
Call SVdP Harambee Kitchen (414) 249-3866 and Cross Roads Kitchen (414) 649-9555 to confirm cost and any entry requirements
Call Capuchin House of Peace (414) 933-1300 before Mon 9/14 — hours not re-verified since 2024
Call Ebenezer Stone Ministries (414) 488-8070 before Sat 9/12 — pop-up is weather-dependent and ~2×/month
At every pantry, say you have no kitchen and ask specifically for no-cook, shelf-stable items (canned pull-tab, peanut butter, crackers, dried fruit, etc.)
Confirm St. Mark AME pantry (9/13) is on the 2nd-Sunday schedule by calling Interchange at (414) 551-2184
Check Jewish Community Pantry website (jccmilwaukee.org) for appointment info — no phone is listed for the pantry
Save shelf-stable items from Thu/Fri pantry visits to cover Sunday 9/13 morning and midday meals
If a site is closed on arrival, use the listed backup resource ID for that day
unmet_needs: No confirmed breakfast or lunch on Sunday 9/13 — rely on shelf-stable no-cook items picked up earlier in the week
No kitchen available all week — all pantry visits require asking specifically for no-cook, shelf-stable items; cooked pantry items cannot be used
Quantity per visit is unknown at every resource — stock cannot be guaranteed
data.explanation: You have no kitchen, no budget, and bus travel. Every day has at least one free meal or pantry option reachable by bus. Free meals (The Gathering, SVdP kitchens, St. Demo) are ready-to-eat and highest priority. Pantry visits are conditional — ask specifically for no-cook, shelf-stable items. All verified-tier resources were checked against official provider pages on 2026-09-08; call-to-confirm records are from the 2024 Milwaukee Food Environment Map. Confirm hours before traveling. res-003 (paid mobile market) is excluded — zero budget.
